titleEn: Royal Decree on the adjustment of Kep city to Kep province

articles.en:
Kep town (Krong Kep) is hereby converted into Kep province (Khet Kep).
Article 2.- The organisational structure and administrative management system of Kep province shall comply with the Law on the Administrative Management of the Capital, Provinces, Municipalities, Districts and Khans.
.
Article 3.- All provisions whose content is contrary to this Royal Decree shall be considered null and void.
- Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia, shall be responsible for implementing this Royal Decree.

- This Royal Decree shall enter into force from the date of signature.
Signed and sealed at the Royal Palace, Phnom Penh, [date illegible], 2008. Norodom Sihamoni.
